scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a VA home purchase loan and I wanted to check on the status of my application. Can you tell me if it has been approved or denied? Also, what is the interest rate I've been assigned?
dialogue.agent: Your VA home purchase loan application has been approved. The interest rate assigned to your loan is 5.625%.

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! Thank you for letting me know. Can you also tell me the total costs associated with this loan and if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: The total costs associated with your loan are $6,738.59. Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage, and it does not have any negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: That's reassuring to know. One more thing, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Yes, your loan has been sold to Ginnie Mae.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for the information. That's all I needed to know.

<Very Satisfied> The agent was polite, professional, and provided clear and concise answers to all of my questions. I feel well-informed and confident about my loan.
